positions.name: DayOldMarkdownTiming
positions.frame: when should day-old loaves be marked down, and what has to change on the shelf when they are?
positions.why: Ines gives the timing of the day-old markdown (half price at two in the afternoon rather than at close) with a reason from closing-time demand. Caleb follows with the shelf card, which changes at the same hour so the till price holds no surprise. Both statements read the same question: the markdown moment and the signage that must move with it. Caleb's statement builds on Ines's, so the set holds no tension. No existing narrative leaf or stratum covers bakery pricing, so no `under` is proposed.
